findings.excerpt: In the opinion of management, the ultimate resolutions of all such currently pending matters will not have a material adverse effect on our consolidated financial position or results of operations.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素僅泛稱未來可能出現涉及反壟斷等的法律或監管事項，未揭露具體反壟斷調查。
findings.excerpt: Additional legal claims or regulatory matters may arise in the future and could involve matters relating to commercial disputes, government regulation and compliance, IP, antitrust, tax, employment or shareholder issues
